name: House League
note: House League spec (E17-L01): eight Divisions replacing the slice's two and the campaign's provisional encounters at integration (E22-L01). Targets are provisional until E24; Divisions 1 and 2 keep the slice's targets. The two new rivals' first-clear items are chosen in the House item batches (Wave 7); their gates are named here.

rivals.name: The Surveyor
rivals.intro: Every line measured, every angle true. The Surveyor allows no charged spin: each ball rolls exactly where it is aimed, so placement and straight-line equipment win this lane.

first_clear.text: Encore joins the shop pool from your next attempt.

reactions.entrance: Plumb, level, true. Show me a straight line.
reactions.confident: Off by a board. I measured it.
reactions.impressed: A true line. Precisely as charted.
reactions.threatened: Your figures are… converging on mine.
reactions.defeated: The survey is complete. You hold the line.
reactions.victorious: Out of true. Recalibrate and return.

rivals.name: The Custodian
rivals.intro: Every lane spotless, every frame finished. The Custodian banks only clean work: strikes and spares. Leave a pin standing and the frame is swept away.

first_clear.text: Standing Order joins the shop pool from your next attempt.

reactions.entrance: Mind the corners. I only count what's cleared.
reactions.confident: Untidy. That one goes in the bin.
reactions.threatened: You're closing in… don't leave a mess now.
reactions.victorious: Swept away. Come back with a cleaner game.

rivals.name: The Proprietor
rivals.intro: The Proprietor owns every board of this alley and the House Ball that rolls on it. In this match you throw the House Ball only; tactical cards are allowed, so your rack, Charms and aim have to carry the score.

first_clear.text: A House item joins the shop pool from your next attempt.

reactions.entrance: House rules, friend. House Ball, house odds.
reactions.impressed: Huh. You make the house look good.
reactions.threatened: Now hold on, that's my lane…
reactions.defeated: The house… concedes. Have a drink on me.
reactions.victorious: The house always wins. Come again.

rivals.name: Old Lou
rivals.intro: Forty years on these lanes and Old Lou still racks the pins himself. In his match every pin plays as plain Wood: materials switch off, so your Charms, balls and modifications have to make the score.

first_clear.text: A House item joins the shop pool from your next attempt.

reactions.entrance: Wood's wood, kid. Let's see your arm.
reactions.confident: Fancy pins won't save you here.
reactions.threatened: Well, I'll be. Slow down, kid.
reactions.defeated: Forty years… and you beat me clean.
reactions.victorious: Come back when you've got more than fancy pins.

rivals.name: The Custodian, House Champion
rivals.intro: The Custodian defends the House title with the Proprietor's blessing: only strikes and spares bank, and you throw the House Ball only. Every frame must be clean, with no special ball to fall back on.

first_clear.text: House League champion: the Royal League opens and the Tournament Kit is available from your next attempt.
